title: Site-specific phosphorylation of Ser352 drives aggregation of Tau R4 under acidosis conditions.
authors: Bressler, Shachar Guy; Blacher, Carmia; Harpaz, Karina Abramov; Grunhaus, Dana; Rudiger, Stefan G D; Hurevich, Mattan; Shalev, Deborah E; Miller, Yifat; Friedler, Assaf
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟与NMR等实验，揭示Tau R4结构域Ser352磷酸化在酸性pH下驱动蛋白从凝聚体向淀粉样纤维转变的分子机制，属于蛋白质构象转变与聚集的结构计算研究，但核心对象为Tau聚集而非经典结构预测/设计，方法创新有限。
abstract: In Alzheimer's disease, neurons undergo acidosis as their pH drops from  approximately 7.1 to  approximately 6.5. Here we elucidate the molecular mechanism of specific Tau aggregation only at this lower pH. We show that a specific phosphorylation event in the Tau R4 domain is coupled to this pH drop to drive a defined phase transition from condensates to fibrils. Using a combination of experimental and computational studies, our results demonstrate that site-specific phosphorylation of Ser352 is the molecular switch that induces aggregation of Tau only at the more acidic, disease-related pH. We designed and synthesized a phosphopeptide library covering all phosphorylation patterns of the Tau-R4 domain and tested its response to controlled acidification using an array of complementary biophysical methods. This revealed that only a single phosphorylation of Ser352 led to acid-driven aggregation of Tau-R4. At neutral pH, Tau-R4 with a phosphorylation on Ser352 formed liquid condensates. These condensates converted irreversibly into amyloid filaments as the pH gradually decreased towards the level associated with pathological acidosis. Using a combination of (31)P- and (1)H-NMR, MD simulations and microscopy studies, we show that the mechanism by which the phosphorylation of Ser352 Tau R4 exerts its effects is based on the unique position of this residue within the protein structure. pSer352 is located at the inside of the tip of a beta-hairpin, pointing into the hydrophobic core of the amyloid fold. This buried position increases its effective pK (a), resulting in compacting of the hairpin following pSer352 protonation upon acidification. This shortens the inter-sheet distance at this position and tightens the filament. We conclude that this single protonation event of the pSer352 phosphate is responsible for the macroscopic phase transition from condensates to aggregates. Our results provide the molecular explanation for the specific aggregation of Tau under the pathologically relevant acidic pH, which is substantially different from its behavior at neutral pH.
abstract_zh: 在阿尔茨海默病中，神经元经历酸中毒，其pH值从约7.1下降至约6.5。在此，我们阐明了仅在此较低pH值下Tau蛋白特异性聚集的分子机制。我们展示了Tau R4结构域中一个特定的磷酸化事件与这一pH下降相耦合，驱动从凝聚体到原纤维的明确相变。通过结合实验与计算研究，我们的结果表明，Ser352的位点特异性磷酸化是仅在更酸性、疾病相关pH值下诱导Tau聚集的分子开关。我们设计并合成了一个覆盖Tau-R4结构域所有磷酸化模式的磷酸肽库，并利用一系列互补的生物物理方法测试其对受控酸化的响应。这揭示出仅Ser352的单一位点磷酸化导致Tau-R4的酸驱动聚集。在中性pH下，Ser352磷酸化的Tau-R4形成液体凝聚体。随着pH逐渐降低至与病理性酸中毒相关的水平，这些凝聚体不可逆地转化为淀粉样纤维。通过结合(31)P-和(1)H-NMR、分子动力学模拟及显微镜研究，我们展示了Ser352磷酸化Tau R4发挥作用的机制基于该残基在蛋白质结构中的独特位置。pSer352位于β-发夹尖端的内侧，指向淀粉样折叠的疏水核心。这一埋藏位置增加了其有效pK (a)，导致酸化时pSer352质子化后发夹结构压缩。这缩短了该位置的片层间距离并使纤维更紧密。我们得出结论，pSer352磷酸基团的这一单次质子化事件负责从凝聚体到聚集体的宏观相变。我们的结果为Tau在病理相关酸性pH下的特异性聚集提供了分子解释，这与其在中性pH下的行为显著不同。
